speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid enlargement of a painless, non-tender breast mass in a 48-year-old woman, I need to determine the nature of the lesion. REQUEST TEST: Mammography with ultrasound. REQUEST IMAGES: Breast_Mammogram_Left_Breast.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography shows a smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast; Biopsy reveals leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth, consistent with a phyllodes tumor.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor of the Left Breast.
